newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish Jan-Feb retail sales seen climbing.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish Jan-Feb retail sales seen climbing.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Tuesday forecast that Danish retail sales for January-February 1997 would rise by an average year-on-year 2.5 percent.
The estimates spanned from a low 2.0 percent to a high 3.0 percent. The equivalent figure for the last recorded period, November-December 1996, was +0.8 percent.
The Danish national statistics office is due to issue its January-February jobless data on Friday April 11 at 0730 gmt. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
